messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Fixed best scores so only a lower move count replaces the record for that grid size. Sizes without a record now show `Best: none`, including after reload.

Validation passed: 140 unit tests and all 77 browser journeys, including the score persistence checks. The fresh build and type checks also passed.

The repository-wide formatting check still reports 13 pre-existing files outside this change; all changed files pass formatting.
